hooks.command: echo '[hook] File modified - remember to run tests'

{ git diff --name-only -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'; git diff --cached --name-only -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'; } | head -1 | grep -q '.' && echo 'Uncommitted .ts/.tsx changes detected. Run validation, review, and commit before stopping.' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
